facts.text: The hotel is set within Amsterdam's former public library.
facts.excerpt: Set within Amsterdam's former public library, Andaz Amsterdam Prinsengracht is a 5-star

facts.text: The hotel was designed by Dutch designer Marcel Wanders.
facts.excerpt: Designed by renowned Dutch designer Marcel Wanders, the hotel celebrates Amsterdam's heritage through imaginative interiors, one-of-a-kind artwork

facts.text: The hotel is located on the UNESCO-listed Prinsengracht canal in Amsterdam-Centrum.
facts.excerpt: Located on the UNESCO-listed Prinsengracht canal, it's a boutique hotel in Amsterdam-Centrum

facts.text: Rooms have views across the Prinsengracht canal, the Secret Garden or the observatorium-inspired atrium.
facts.excerpt: With views across the Prinsengracht canal, the Secret Garden or the observatorium-inspired atrium

facts.text: The Prinsengracht Suite is the hotel's signature penthouse, with a kitchenette and a private library/study.
facts.excerpt: sophisticated interiors include a king bedroom with a rotating television, spacious living and dining areas, a kitchenette and a private library/study

facts.text: The Prinsengracht Suite's bathroom features Marcel Wanders' signature soap bar bathtub.
facts.excerpt: The oversized bathroom features Marcel Wanders' signature soap bar bathtub, a walk-in shower and an integrated TV mirror.

facts.text: One room type has a private terrace overlooking the Secret Garden.
facts.excerpt: A private terrace overlooking the Secret Garden sets this guestroom apart

facts.text: Rooms include a complimentary minibar with non-alcoholic beverages, beer and local snacks.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary minibar with non-alcoholic beverages, beer and local snacks

facts.text: Rooms have an open-concept bathroom with a walk-in shower.
facts.excerpt: The inviting retreat includes a queen bed, large workspace and an open-concept bathroom with walk-in rain shower.

facts.text: Renvy is a chef-led restaurant guided by Michelin-starred chef Randy Karman.
facts.excerpt: Guided by the vision of Michelin-starred chef Randy Karman, Renvy combines local ingredients and refined technique

facts.text: Prins & Aap hosts a daily Jenever Hour introducing one of the Netherlands' best-known spirits, free for in-house guests.
facts.excerpt: The experience is free for in-house guests

facts.text: The hotel's vintage saloon boat offers 60 or 90 minute canal cruises with private dining, departing right in front of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Embark on an enchanting journey with our vintage saloon boat, awaiting your arrival right in front of the hotel. Choose between a captivating 60 or 90 minute cruise through scenic views with private dining.

facts.text: Essence Spa offers tailor-made treatments.
facts.excerpt: Discover pure relaxation at Essence Spa at the Andaz Amsterdam Prinsengracht. Escape the city’s hustle and indulge in tailor-made treatments

facts.text: The hotel has a 24-hour fitness center.
facts.excerpt: 24-Hour Fitness Center

facts.text: Through the Very Important Dog program, dogs receive a Cloud7 dog bed and blanket, designer bowls and bottled mineral water.
facts.excerpt: Through our Very Important Dog (VID) program, your four-legged companion will enjoy thoughtful amenities, including a Cloud7 dog bed and blanket, designer bowls and bottled mineral water

facts.text: Guest bicycles are available for exploring Amsterdam.
facts.excerpt: Guest bicycles available for exploring Amsterdam

facts.text: The hotel's underground parking has limited spaces and is available only through valet parking, subject to availability.
facts.excerpt: the hotel offers secure underground parking with limited spaces, available exclusively through valet parking and subject to availability

facts.text: The nearby Prinsengracht tram stop gives access to the Van Gogh Museum, the Rijksmuseum and Vondelpark.
facts.excerpt: Prinsengracht Tram Stop (1, 2, 5)

facts.text: There is no reception desk; staff greet guests and escort them to standing desks in the lobby for check-in.
facts.excerpt: There's also no reception area—hotel staff greet you and escort you to one of three standing desks in the lobby for check-in.

facts.text: Rooms feature tulip-inspired chairs and walls with Delftware-like blue and white tiles.
facts.excerpt: Features include bright yellow tulip-inspired chairs and walls decked out in Delftware-like blue and white tiles

facts.text: Parking is limited throughout the hotel's Canal District neighborhood.
facts.excerpt: Located within Amsterdam's UNESCO-listed Canal District, parking is limited throughout the neighborhood.
